root_idea.summary: The root centers on a thing moving onward or flowing along a course.
root_idea.development: From the movement of water, the root extends to running or proceeding of ships, animals, celestial bodies, and other things; it also develops figurative senses of following a course, acting as another's agent, and adopting a customary way. The bird-crop term جِرِّيَّة is treated separately in the lexical evidence as probably involving substitution from قاف.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.

The Quranic plural active participle is normalized to the supported singular citation form جَارِيَة.
The plural active-participial form جَوَارِ is presented under its supported singular citation form جَارِيَة.
Displayed under the normalized noun citation form مَجْرًى.

senses.definition: To run, flow, or move onward along a course.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of flowing water and of things that proceed or travel, including ships and moving celestial bodies; the Quranic uses include both literal flowing and directed movement along a course.
An active participle used adjectivally of something in motion; in the Quran it describes a flowing spring and, in plural forms, things that run or sail.
A substantivized active participle, named for its movement upon the sea; the plural جَوَارِ is used for sailing vessels.

senses.definition: A course or route along which something runs.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction مَجْرَاهَا, it denotes the course of the ship; the broader noun can also refer to a physical channel or passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pervade or spread through the ears of grain, as flour does in the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction جَرَى الدَّقِيقُ فِي السُّنْبُلِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run, especially of a horse or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical specialization of the general motion verb, applied to an animal capable of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct oneself toward, make one's aim, intend, or hasten to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction جَرَى إِلَى or جَرَى إِلَيْهِ takes a destination or intended object; it is also used of hastening toward something disapproved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a dispute or controversy to proceed or continue concerning something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction used of disagreement or controversy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue or befall someone; to happen or occur to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with لَهُ or عَلَيْهِ in the relevant idiomatic constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be like something else in condition, or to follow the same rule or course; to affect someone similarly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction of analogy, equivalence, or conformity, including grammatical conformity and similar effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint, commission, or send someone as an agent, deputy, or messenger to carry out an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived Form II verb may mean making someone a جَرِيّ or sending him to accomplish a need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run with someone and, figuratively, to vie or compete with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction extends from literal running together to rivalry in an affair, discussion, or disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something run or set it in motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used causatively of water, tears, horses, ships, and similar moving things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something permanent or continual for someone, including to provide a regular allowance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ or لَهُ in the sense of continuing a provision or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something equivalent to, analogous to, or subject to the same rule as something else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may concern similarity of condition, grammatical position, or practical effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand or desire that someone or something run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request or desiderative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Because of you, on your account, or for your sake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed prepositional expression equivalent to مِنْ أَجْلِكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode, manner, or degree of running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used especially of the manner or vehemence of water's running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Girlhood or the state of being a young girl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression فِي أَيَّامِ جَرَائِهَا, “in the days of her girlhood.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A commissioned agent, factor, or deputy who acts in another's affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes one who operates in the place or interest of the person who appoints him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A messenger or person sent to carry out an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A related agentive use, distinguished from the broader terms for messenger and representative in some lexical descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A servant, hired man, or hireling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended social and occupational use of the agentive noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A surety, guarantor, or person responsible for another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of one accountable or answerable for someone else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bold or daring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the hamzated headword جَرِيء, distinct in spelling from جَرِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or function of an agent, deputy, or messenger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun derivative referring to the role or office held by a جَرِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A continuing daily allowance of food or similar provision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use associated with a regular provision for servants or dependants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eel, a particular well-known fish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The crop, craw, or first stomach of a bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun for the pouch into which food passes; the lexical evidence treats it as related to قِرِّيَّة with a consonant substitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A continuing or perpetual charitable donation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participial adjective جَارِيَة modifies a charity whose benefit or provision continues.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun, its disk, or a star in motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized feminine active participle named for the celestial body's movement across the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun based on the wind's movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl or young woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is associated lexically with youthful activity; it may also be used of a female slave, including one no longer young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social-status use distinct from the basic meaning “girl” or “young woman.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eye of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A benefit, favor, boon, or blessing bestowed by God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind or mode of running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural refers to a horse possessing several kinds or styles of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun for running as an activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A custom, habit, or adopted manner that one follows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from a course of running to a habitual course of conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature, constitution, or natural disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an established quality belonging to someone's character or constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A channel, duct, conduit, or other passage through which a fluid runs; also a place or time of running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader nominal use of مَجْرًى beyond the Quranic expression meaning a course or route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes a horse or other thing run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle used substantively, illustrated by a saying about one who exercises a horse in an empty place.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Ship movement is covered by the Quranic motion sense.
Celestial movement is covered by the motion sense.
Similar-effect construction is grouped with analogy.

Demanding or desiring that something run.

cautions: The QAC groups جَارِيَة, جَارِيَات, and جَوَارِ are presented under the singular citation form جَارِيَة; the Quranic contexts distinguish flowing things from sailing vessels and other runners.
The Quranic context for جَوَارِ at 81:16 is rendered as “those that run,” while other occurrences clearly refer to ships; the referent should not be made uniformly nautical.
جِرِّيَّة, the bird-crop term, is lexically distinguished in the supplied evidence from the ordinary running branch and is associated there with a possible قاف-to-جيم substitution.
